notes.title: 0.24 - SAH-46 Chicane Release
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=i6IiLtNdLT4;full][/previewyoutube]

Changelog:

[h1]Content[/h1]

• SAH-46 Chicane stealth attack helicopter
• AGR-18 Lynchpin guided rockets, available for Chicane and Cricket
• 1.5kt nuclear bomb, available for Compass, Revoker and Darkreach
• New mission: "Infiltration" featuring the SAH-46 Chicane
• Helipad structure

[h1]Features[/h1]

• Added ability for hosts to kick players from their game
• Improved ground unit awareness of nearby friendlies to avoid friendly fire (WIP)
• Increased weighting of cursor distance when selecting targets on HUD
• Improved reliability of Boltstrike missiles and interception rate against bombs
• Bombing coundown timer made more accurate for lofting trajectories
• Removed 500kg bombs loadout option from Cricket
• Added waterline HUD marker for all aircraft
• Compass nose landing gear strengthened
• Added level of detail meshes for Compass

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]

• Fixed default nuclear loadouts persisting to missions with nuclear weapons not authorized
• Fixed players able to fire weapons after being killed
• Fixed nuclear cruise missiles detonating on ground if stalled
• Fixed window not maximizing when fullscreen selected from graphics settings
• Fixed airbase selection not working if mission failure/success screen shown in current play session
• Fixed repaired buildings not having their hitpoints restored
• Improvements to multiplayer security to make exploits more difficult

[h1]Visuals[/h1]

• Improved visuals for high altitude nuclear explosions and mushroom clouds on uneven terrain
• Improved visuals for craters and scorch marks
• Improved visuals for cannon shell explosions
• Improved visuals for RAM-45 missile, IRM-S1 launcher
• Nuclear and thermobaric explosions now remove trees in their vicinity

notes.title: Patch 0.23
notes.content:
• Added slider to Mission Editor to control score threshold to unlock nuclear weapons
• Added copy/paste unit attributes buttons to Mission Editor
• Players can now disembark from aircraft while parked at a friendly airbase without mission failure even if "Allow Player Respawn" is not enabled
• Added bonus score for players who return to base after a sortie, adjustable in Mission Editor
• Fixed AI aircraft having too much knowledge of target position when not visible to sensors
• Airbases are no longer capturable by air units, only ground vehicles
• Added Spawn Timing dropdown functionality in Mission Editor

• Added new missile warning info above map screen, and warning lights to Cricket and Compass cockpits
• HUD selection of targets now prioritizes targets by viability of the selected weapon

• AI aircraft use improved tactics when dogfighting and are more accurate at leading fast-moving targets
• AI bombers now prioritize using cruise missiles at long ranges
• AI now always choose nuclear-equipped loadouts when they are unlocked
• AI aircraft now use notching and radar jammer when targeted by radar guided SAMs

• Added max players slider to multiplayer hosting UI
• Number of players in a game is now displayed in the list
• Added refresh button to multiplayer game list

• Added settlement and airstrip to southern tip of Boscali Island
• Fixed missing collision for some roads and a hole in the terrain south of Highway Strip 1


• FS-12 Revoker: slightly increased effective wing area for improved turning performance at lower speeds
• FS-12 Revoker: adjusted auto-trimmer to fix instances of uncontrolled pitch down
• FS-12 Revoker: added yaw thrust vectoring

• Fixed scorch marks and craters rendering over the top of ground units

• Tuned aircraft damage model to make fires more likely after being hit by missiles
• Tuned pilot damage model to make pilots much more vulnerable to explosions and bullet hits
• Disabled engines no longer totally lose their IR signature
• Adjusted jet engine performance at various altitudes for all aircraft

• Tweaked Total War scenario to give PALA a more defensible highway strip

• Added directionality, mach cone, and sonic booms to jet engine audio
